subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
4.
CA Rajesh decided to go for sampling for verification of controls, transactions
and for applying substantive procedures. In this regard, select a statement
from the below options, which is not apt:
(A)  It is possible to make 100% examination of test of controls.
(B)  100% examination may be made of a population constituting a small
number of large value items.
(C)  100% examination is appropriate when there is a significant risk, and
other means do not provide sufficient appropriate audit evidence.
(D)  The repetitive nature of calculation or other process performed
automatically by an information system, makes a 100% examination
cost effective.
(2Marks)
